title: PEBench: A Fictitious Dataset to Benchmark Machine Unlearning for Multimodal Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on machine unlearning (MU) techniques for Multimodal Large Language Models to address privacy and security concerns. While it mentions 'ethical and safety concerns' as motivation in the introduction, the benchmark itself evaluates the removal of fictitious personal identities and event scenes, rather than evaluating religion, theology, or moral frameworks.
